importNu.heading: Import from NovelUpdates
importNu.tutorialTitle: How to export your NovelUpdates reading list
importNu.tutorialStep1: Log in to NovelUpdates. If your reading list is missing, open the Reading List page and enable it from Global Settings (top right).
importNu.tutorialStep2: In the same Global Settings panel, click "Export Reading List". This downloads an XML file (for backup purposes only).
importNu.tutorialStep3: Upload that XML file below. Novels are matched to your library by title; reading progress is read from the chapter field (e.g. v0c12).
